definitions.gloss: (mobile phone) coverage area; service area; area within signal range
definitions.explanation: The geographical area in which a mobile phone or other wireless device can make and receive calls through a carrier's network. Going outside this area results in dropped calls or no signal.

examples.japanese: {通話圏外|つうわけんがい}だ。
⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通話圏|つうわけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: You often fall out of the coverage area deep in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {契約前|けいやくまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{通話圏内|つうわけんない}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よい。
examples.english: Before signing a contract, it's a good idea to check whether your home is in the coverage area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{通話圏|つうわけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、ずいぶん⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧になった。
examples.english: Recently subway stations have also been brought into the coverage area, which has made things much more convenient.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{通話|つうわ}→通話：14369_tsuuwa⟧ (phone call, communication) and ⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧ (sphere, range, zone). A telecommunications term that is most familiar to ordinary users through the phrase {通話圏外|つうわけんがい} (out of the coverage area) displayed on mobile phones.

USAGE:
{通話圏|つうわけん} itself is less commonly seen standalone than as part of the compounds {通話圏内|つうわけんない} (in the coverage area) and {通話圏外|つうわけんがい} (out of the coverage area). These fixed pairs are the practical forms learners will encounter most often.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通話圏内|つうわけんない}: within the coverage area
- {通話圏外|つうわけんがい}: out of the coverage area
- {通話圏|つうわけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: to fall outside the coverage area
- {通話圏|つうわけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: to have a wide coverage area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サービスエリア→サービスエリア：11333_saabisueria⟧: service area — the carrier-marketing term, frequently seen in ads and coverage maps
- ⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: the signal reaches — a more casual way to describe the same idea ("I have reception here")
- ⟦{圏外|けんがい}→圏外：07689_kengai⟧: out of range — the short form commonly shown on a phone's screen when it has no signal
